name: Build and simulate an AND circuit
description: Verifies a user can place logic components, wire them, and observe a simulated output.
steps: Place an AND gate and two input switches
Connect both switches to the gate and connect the gate to the LED output
expected: The output LED is OFF unless both input switches are ON, and becomes ON when both are ON.

name: Place and move components on mobile
description: Checks that core circuit-building interactions remain usable on a narrow screen.
steps: Add a NOT gate to the canvas
Select the gate and drag it to a different position
expected: The gate remains visible at the new position and the canvas controls stay accessible.

name: Disconnect and remove a circuit component
description: Verifies wiring can be removed and deleting a component cleans up its connected wires.
steps: Add two input switches and an OR gate
Connect the inputs to the OR gate
Delete one wire, then delete the OR gate
expected: The selected wire disappears, and deleting the gate removes its remaining attached wires without breaking the workbench.

name: Use a chip and a numeric display
description: Verifies a digital IC and display component can be placed and show the logic state connected to them.
steps: Add a 74HC08 AND chip and a seven-segment display
Connect input switches to the chip inputs
Connect one chip output to a display input
expected: The IC and display appear on the canvas with labelled pins, and the display updates according to the evaluated input.
